description_html:
Key Features

  • High-Capacity Vessel: 383-litre volume allows for large-scale halophile culture brine processing, ideal for industrial and laboratory applications requiring significant batch sizes.
  • Optimized Working Temperature: Maintains a stable operating temperature of 23°C, supporting optimal growth conditions for halophilic microorganisms and consistent fermentation results.
  • Extended Batch Cycle: Supports batch cycles of up to 169 days, making it suitable for long-term culturing processes and reducing the need for frequent intervention.
  • Simultaneous Batch Capability: Capable of handling up to 10 batches at once, increasing throughput and efficiency for users with high production demands.
  • Sealed Pressurized Atmosphere Control: Features a sealed and pressurized vessel design, ensuring a controlled environment that minimizes contamination risks and maintains brine quality throughout the process.
  • Custom Pricing: Unit price is determined post-acceptance, allowing for tailored quotes based on specific project requirements or volume needs.

Main Benefits

  • Efficient Large-Scale Production: The high vessel volume and ability to manage multiple simultaneous batches streamline operations for users seeking to maximize output.
  • Consistent Quality: Precise temperature control and a sealed, pressurized system ensure reliable and repeatable results, critical for research, manufacturing, and quality control.
  • Reduced Maintenance Needs: Long batch cycles decrease downtime and labor associated with frequent batch turnover, saving time and operational costs.
  • Enhanced Contamination Protection: The pressurized, sealed environment protects cultures from external contaminants, improving yield and reducing waste.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Industrial Fermentation: Suitable for commercial-scale halophile culture production in food, biotechnology, or pharmaceutical industries.
  • Research & Development: Ideal for laboratories conducting long-term studies on halophilic organisms, salt-tolerant bacteria, or brine fermentation processes.
  • Quality Assurance: Used in environments where maintaining batch purity and process consistency is essential for regulatory compliance or product development.
  • Custom Manufacturing Projects: Adaptable to unique project needs, with flexible pricing and scalable batch handling to support diverse operational requirements.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Is the vessel easy to operate and maintain? Yes, the system is designed for straightforward operation with extended batch cycles, reducing the need for frequent intervention.
  • Is this brine tun compatible with standard laboratory or industrial setups? The vessel’s design and atmosphere control features make it suitable for integration into most standard fermentation setups.
  • How is durability ensured? The sealed, pressurized construction is engineered for long-term use, minimizing contamination and wear.
